thread:
oncall-bot: [ALERT] 1732501234 - auth-service: audit-log-write errors spiking in us-east-1 (>95% failed writes over 5m). Pager: alex.k

alex.k: ack. I'm jumping in.

alex.k: checking pods and logs now. can folks avoid mass restarts until we know what's happening?

mira.sre: I'm on infra. grabbing recent kube events and container logs. @alex.k do we have the runbook link?

alex.k: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/audit-log-failure — follow mitigation steps 1-4, but do not rotate keys yet.

oncall-bot: Automated mitigation: rerouting audit writes -> fallback-s3-bucket (read-only), hoping to preserve events.

mira.sre: observed audit-writer container CrashLoopBackOff on 3/3 replicas. kube events show OOMKilled and later permission denied on PUT to S3. logs: 
```
ERROR 2026-02-12T02:14:03Z writer.go:213 putObject failed: AccessDenied: Access Denied
	status code: 403, request id: ABC123
```

sec-jordan: joining. This is a compliance-sensitive gap if audit events didn't persist. Do NOT delete any PVs or rotate service accounts until we collect evidence.

sre-rachel: quick customer impact check: auth events may be missing from audit logs for the window ~02:12-02:24 UTC. Possible impact: customers relying on audit trails for SSO/SCIM will see incomplete records.

pm-arya: drafting a holding notice for affected customers. Will share a muted template for review.

alex.k: mitigation step executed: temporarily scaled audit-writer -> 6 replicas to absorb backlog and enabled fallback writer to S3. Command run: 
```
kubectl scale deploy audit-writer -n infra-prod --replicas=6
kubectl apply -f fallback-writer-enable.yaml -n infra-prod
```

mira.sre: creating EBS snapshots of audit-writer PVCs now to preserve evidence: 
```
aws ec2 create-snapshot --volume-id vol-0abcd1234 --description "audit-writer-incident-1732501234"
```
Snapshot IDs: snap-0a1b2c3d etc.

sec-jordan: initial triage: 1) Permission denied indicates RBAC/STS role change when deploy X rolled out 02:10 UTC. 2) OOMKilled suggests memory pressure after retry storms. Root likely interaction of deploy + policy change.

eng-lead-omar: confirm: was there a deploy at ~02:09? deploy-bot, can you post?

oncall-bot: deploy-bot: deploy auth-service v2.14.3 started at 2026-02-12T02:09:46Z and completed at 02:10:12Z.

mira.sre: found a recent change in iam-role-mapping config in the deploy which removed s3:PutObject for the audit-writer role in the kube manifest. Reverting that should restore writes.

alex.k: plan: 1) revert iam-role-mapping for audit-writer (hotfix) 2) keep fallback writer active for 1h 3) reprocess backlog to reconcile missing events 4) collect evidence and schedule postmortem.

sec-jordan: agree. Also: preserve all snapshots and upload them to secure evidence bucket with write-once retention. I'll take ownership of evidence collection.

mira.sre: applying hotfix now: 
```
kubectl apply -f iam-role-mapping-revert.yaml -n infra-prod
```
Rolled back, confirming credentials can PutObject again.

mira.sre: verification: live writer status returning OK, no more 403s in logs after 02:16 UTC. fallback writer will continue for safety until backfill completes.

pm-arya: customer comms: draft ready, internal review requested. draft link: https://redwood.internal/drafts/audit-gap-1732501234 — please add comments by EOD.

legal-zoe: please include exact window of missing events, list of affected endpoints, and note that we preserved snapshots. We may need to provide regulators the preserved snapshots.

alex.k: quick calc: estimated missing event count ~12k events (auth/sign-in/scim). We'll re-ingest from fallback and re-run integrity checks.

sre-rachel: creating follow-up tickets in JIRA: AUD-2312 (restore missing audit events), SEC-998 (evidence preservation), INFRA-441 (runbook updates + e2e for iam mapping).

sec-jordan: ACTIONS assigned: 
- sec-jordan: collect and upload EBS snapshots + container logs to secure-evidence-bucket (due: today EOD)
- mira.sre: run the re-ingest job and validate event counts (due: tomorrow noon)
- alex.k: produce incident timeline initial draft (due: tomorrow 10:00 UTC)
- eng-lead-omar: review deploy CI that allowed iam-role removal and add guardrails (due: next Tue)
- legal-zoe: prepare compliance report template for auditors (due: next Wed)

mira.sre: re-ingest started. Command: 
```
python tools/reingest.py --source s3://fallback-audit/1732501234/ --target audit-db --start 2026-02-12T02:12:00Z --end 2026-02-12T02:24:00Z
```
I will post validation results in this thread when done.

alex.k: scheduling postmortem: proposing Thu 11am PST (2026-02-13 19:00 UTC). invite sent to participants + ops + security + legal. If you can't make it, add comments in the doc.

legal-zoe: please include the preserved evidence location in the postmortem; we'll need chain-of-custody notes.

eng-lead-omar: long-term remediations suggested: 1) CI lint to block iam-role removals unless explicit ack 2) add metric for "audit-writes succeed ratio" with alert at <99% 3) end-to-end test in deploy pipeline writing sample audit events and verifying S3 PutObject.

pm-arya: customer update checklist: internal review -> legal approval -> targeted customer notifications for customers on compliance plans -> public status page note if material.

oncall-bot: Incident status: mitigated. Postmortem scheduled. Creating a consolidated incident record: INCIDENT-1732501234.

alex.k: thanks everyone for quick responses. Let's keep evidence preserved and keep communication tight. I'll paste the postmortem doc link when the initial timeline is up. :thumbsup:

sec-jordan: note for follow-up: check audit-log retention/replication to other regions — if we lost the primary writes, replication should have caught it. Add as action: replicate to us-west-2 within 1 hour.

mira.sre: recorded the replication action. Adding to INFRA-441.

sre-rachel: closing loop: on-call handover will include a short summary for next shift in the #eng-oncall channel.

alex.k: last: please treat the evidence snapshots as sensitive. No sharing outside assigned folks.

legal-zoe: noted. I'll start a secure ticket for regulator-facing evidence delivery.

oncall-bot: Thread closed by alex.k at 1732501850.
